rules: Main on-screen person: a woman aged 35-50, business owner look. No religious or national attire (no hijab). No cartoon or 3D characters. No text over faces.

problems: The client requested a woman aged 35-50 with a business owner look, but the hook and finale feature much younger women or generic hands.
The hook title sticker covers the upper face/eyes of the person in the opening shot.
Stock footage feels slightly generic (hands typing on laptop, hands holding phone) rather than showing the unique AI Co-pilot interface.
qa.fix: Cast an authentic boutique owner aged 35-50 actively curating her inventory and demonstrating the InClick interface rather than using generic stock hands and younger models.
